description.en: Starts a talk lock: sets global flag 1403 (read by IsTalkLock) and creates the talk-lock icons (CMND_CREATE_TALK_ICON_FOR_TL). If arguments are given, they are collected into an array and passed to CMND_SET_TALK_LOCK_CHARA; the events pass a type (e.g. TL_TYPE_B), a number, then NPC IDs. EndTalkLock ends it.
Values passed as an array to CMND_SET_TALK_LOCK_CHARA (type, number, NPC IDs...).

examples.case: A talk lock on six NPCs before a map jump (real usage, from ev42011250.nut)
